title: Vikram and Betal: The Honest King’s Test
moral: Honesty is more important than success.

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a king’s test.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a king testing honesty.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: People planted seeds and brought plants.
scenes.image_prompt: people bringing plants to king cartoon

scenes.text: One boy brought an empty pot honestly.
scenes.image_prompt: boy holding empty pot nervously cartoon

scenes.text: The king said the seeds were boiled and could not grow.
The boy was rewarded for honesty. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: king rewarding boy while others look surprised cartoon

story: A king tested honesty with boiled seeds. Only one boy told the truth and was rewarded. Vikram said honesty matters more than success.
